title: Yoddha prep meals: pilot week (13-19 Oct), Chinmay
versionNote: Pilot week, approved 13 Oct 2026. Fully vegetarian and egg-free (festival to 20 Oct; Mon/Thu vegetarian).
assumptions: Every day 13-19 Oct is vegetarian with no eggs (festival 11-20 Oct; eggs not allowed on vegetarian days).
Protein powder is already purchased. It's priced at an estimate (₹2,500/kg) because the format can't exclude a food from the budget, so the app's daily cost includes it.
A spice allowance of about ₹10/day (salt, spices, ginger, garlic, chilli, lemon, coriander) isn't in the app's cost.
Vegetable and fruit prices are Mumbai aggregator prices from 12 Oct; packaged goods are DMart / BigBasket listings from 13 Oct. Check against your own shop.
Energy targets are estimates; calibrate with the weekly body-weight trend.

targets.fluidNote: About 3 L a day as a starting point, more on hot days; pale-yellow urine is the check. 350-650 ml in the 2-4 h before training; sip 400-800 ml per hour during. After a sweaty session replace about 1.25-1.5 L per kg lost, with salt (salted food or ORS). Weighing more after a session than before means you drank too much.
targets.rationale: Mifflin-St Jeor resting energy about 1,640 kcal x activity 1.6-1.75 (office job assumed + 60-75 min training). Training days 2,600-2,850 kcal and carbs 335-470 g (5-7 g/kg); rest days 2,350-2,550 kcal and carbs 270-400 g. Protein 1.6-2.0 g/kg (ISSN 1.4-2.0). No deficit: calibrate with the weekly body-weight trend.

meals.name: Kanda-batata poha + dahi
meals.prep: Rinse poha, drain 5 min. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, add onion, diced potato and peas, cook till potato is soft, add peanuts, turmeric and salt, fold in poha, steam 2 min. Lemon on top.
substitutions: Sooji upma or oats instead of poha.

meals.name: 3 roti + rice + moong dal + bhindi sabzi (packed)
meals.prep: Pressure-cook dal 3 whistles; tadka with onion, tomato, jeera. Bhindi: dry-fry sliced okra, then masala.
substitutions: Any seasonal sabzi (cabbage, gobi) for bhindi; masoor or toor for moong.

meals.name: Protein shake + banana
meals.prep: 1 scoop in 300 ml water.

meals.name: 2 bananas (+ creatine as usual)
meals.prep: Eat 60-75 min before the 9 pm session.

meals.name: Protein shake (water)
meals.prep: Within 30 min of finishing.

meals.name: Rice + soy chunk curry + cucumber raita
meals.prep: Boil soy chunks 5 min, squeeze out water. Onion-tomato masala, add chunks and simmer 10 min. Raita: dahi + grated cucumber + roasted jeera.
substitutions: Rajma or chole for soy (use 55 g dry).

meals.name: Besan chilla (3) + dahi
meals.prep: Whisk besan with water to a pouring batter, add chopped onion, tomato, palak, ajwain, salt. Cook thin chillas on a tawa with a little oil.
substitutions: Moong dal chilla (soaked moong dal, ground).

meals.name: Rajma-chawal + salad (packed)
meals.prep: Soak rajma overnight (Tue night). Pressure-cook 6-7 whistles, then simmer in onion-tomato masala.
substitutions: Kabuli chana or whole moong for rajma.

meals.name: Protein shake + papaya
meals.prep: 1 scoop in 300 ml water.

meals.name: 3 roti + rice + matar paneer + toor dal
meals.prep: Matar paneer in onion-tomato gravy. Plain toor dal with a simple tadka.
substitutions: Soy chunks (35 g dry) for paneer to save about ₹20.

meals.name: Vegetable upma + dahi
meals.prep: Dry-roast sooji. Temper mustard, curry leaves, onion, carrot, peas in oil; add 2.5x water, salt, boil, stir in sooji.

meals.name: Chole + 3 roti + rice + salad (packed)
meals.prep: Soak chana overnight (Wed night); pressure-cook 5-6 whistles; chole masala.

meals.name: Rice + masoor dal + aloo-gobi + dahi
meals.prep: Masoor cooks in 2 whistles. Aloo-gobi dry sabzi.

meals.name: Masala oats + dahi
meals.prep: Saute onion, carrot, peas in oil with spices, add oats and 2 cups water, cook 4-5 min.

meals.name: 3 roti + rice + soya-matar sabzi + moong dal (packed)
meals.prep: Soak/boil soy, squeeze, cook with peas in onion-tomato masala.

meals.name: 2 bananas + 2 tsp jaggery (+ creatine)
meals.prep: Test day: a little extra carbohydrate.

meals.name: Moong dal khichdi + cabbage sabzi + dahi
meals.prep: Rice + moong dal 1:1 with 4x water, pressure-cook 3 whistles, ghee-jeera tadka.

meals.name: Idli (6) + sambar + ghee
meals.prep: Home batter: 3 parts rice to 1 part urad, soak 5 h on Friday, grind, ferment overnight. Sambar: toor dal + veg + sambar masala.

meals.name: Protein shake + banana + peanuts
meals.prep: Rest day: one scoop is enough.

meals.name: 3 roti + rice + soy chunk sabzi + palak moong dal (early dinner)
meals.prep: Early dinner so you can be asleep by about 1 am before Sunday's run.

meals.name: 1 banana before the run
meals.prep: 300-400 ml water on waking.

meals.name: Moong dal chilla (3) + dahi + banana
meals.prep: Soak moong dal Sat night (4+ h), grind with ginger and chilli, add onion-tomato, cook like dosa.

meals.name: 3 roti + rice + paneer bhurji + salad (early dinner)
meals.prep: Crumble paneer into onion-tomato masala, 3-4 min. Early dinner = earlier bedtime tonight.
substitutions: Soy bhurji (40 g dry soy) to save about ₹20.

meals.name: Matar poha + dahi
meals.prep: As Tuesday, with peas instead of potato.
